This compound is identified as a target of multiple entities, including Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 2B1, Vismodegib, and Nystatin. These entities are known to interact with the transporter family member 1B3, indicating a possible mechanism of action involving this transporter. The evidence suggests that the compound may influence the activity of the transporter, potentially through direct interaction or by modulating the activity of its targets. The consistent presence of the compound as a target of multiple entities, along with the known targets of these entities, supports a plausible pathway where the compound may interact with the transporter family member 1B3. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the relationships are inferred through multiple pathways, and further experimental validation would be needed to confirm the direct interaction.
